left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria
  -  Patients will be recruited from the Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology and the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN
-  Adult  [AND] patients with immune mediated enteropathies  [AND] who have had improvement in symptoms  [OR] and histology on oral budesonide therapy

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria
  -  Age <18 years
  -  Positive stool gluten testing  [AND] in patients with refractory celiac disease
  -  Small bowel malignancy  [OR] or history of small bowel malignancy
  -  Refractory celiac disease type 2
  -  Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder associated enteropathy
  -  No prior improvement in symptoms  [OR] and histology  [AND] with budesonide therapy
  -  Discontinuation of budesonide therapy prior to the trial
  -  Other concurrent systemic corticosteroids
  -  Other immune mediating medications, for example but not limited to azathioprine, [OR]  6-mercaptopurine, [OR]  cyclosporine, [OR]  methotrexate, [OR]  anti-TNF monoclonal antibodies, [OR]  alpha-4 beta-7 integrin inhibiting monoclonal antibody, [OR]  interleukin 12/23 inhibiting monoclonal antibody, [OR]  JAK inhibitors
